entries.title: Factorio
entries.definitive_edition: Factorio on Windows PC with Space Age expansion

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Space Age expansion
primary.why: The PC release supports the current Factorio base game, the Space Age expansion, modding, and the strongest keyboard/mouse and capture setup. Switch 2 also has unabridged Space Age, but PC remains the highest-fidelity and most flexible archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Factorio on Steam, GOG, or Factorio.com for Windows PC and add Factorio: Space Age for the full current content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Space Age is paid expansion DLC, not a separate sequel. Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is a platform upgrade/access route; the original Switch version does not include Space Age.
